questions.question: Which cloud service model provides virtualized computing resources over the internet, where the provider manages the physical infrastructure and the customer is responsible for managing the operating system, middleware, and applications?

An organization wants to keep its highly sensitive customer data on a private, on-premises infrastructure while hosting its public-facing e-commerce web application in a public cloud. Which cloud deployment model does this scenario describe?
In cloud computing, what is the term used to describe the ability of a system to automatically scale its resource capacity dynamically up or down in response to real-time changes in workload demand?
Under the Shared Responsibility Model of major public cloud providers, which of the following is typically the sole responsibility of the customer?

options.A: Physical security of the data centers hosting the services
options.B: Patching and maintaining the hypervisor layer
options.C: Securing and managing customer data and application access control
options.D: Disposal of decommissioned physical hard drives
